subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Recipient], We are pleased to confirm your flight booking for your upcoming trip from New York to London. Your flight details are as follows: Flight Number: AB1234 Departure: 06/15/2022 10:00 AM from JFK Airport Arrival: 06/15/2022 10:00 PM at Heathrow Airport Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before the departure time. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact us. We wish you a pleasant journey! Best regards, Flight Booking Team
